name: Signed Latin Tokens In RTL Text Are Isolated (+10, S+, Lv.4+ drawn as written)
note: Written with the gate on 2026-10-06 for the Saudi launch. Each mutation takes the isolate off one kind of token the browser measured flipping.

mutations.name: the Lv.4+ mission title loses its isolate
mutations.why: A trailing sign after a level: drawn +Lv.4 on the daily mission card.

mutations.name: the time-attack penalty loses its isolate
mutations.why: A leading sign on a number: +10 drawn 10+ in the header during Speedrun.

mutations.name: the S+ achievement loses its isolate
mutations.why: A grade letter with a sign: S+ drawn +S, the shape Diary 92 fixed on the victory screen but not in this achievement.

mutations.name: the achievement points lose their <bdi>
mutations.why: The component glues the sign itself: the Arabic store screenshot showed (10+) next to every tier (2026-10-07). The dictionary scan cannot see it.
mutations.expectFailure: in JSX is drawn after the number
